_comment: Static audio build manifest (DOJP-35). One entry per deliverable. Timeline steps: {sfx} | {tts} | {robot_tts} | {silence_ms}, each with optional gain_db / fade_out_ms. Optional bed: an SFX looped under the whole timeline. {tts} renders in the entry's narrator voice (per voice folder); {robot_tts} always renders in the scanner-robot ElevenLabs voice (robot_voice_id below) regardless of narrator. Mastered to the app's TARGET_DBFS; exported stereo via free_pool.export_audio_segment (DOJP-56).

scanning.description: The /scanning warm-up clip. Airport call under Hugo's deputy/new-sky monologue, robot activation + deep-scan, robot scan line, radio static with five deep-scans. Script rewritten 2026-10-02 (Hamish reference removed - evergreen).

timeline.tts: Air Traffic Controller Hugo here, and how splendid - my trusty co-pilot has reported for duty! Now, I'll let you in on a little secret, old chum: no two skies are ever quite the same. Every scan finds new jet planes, dashing off to new corners of the world on adventures all of their own. So - ears sharp, eyes to the heavens, and let us see who's up there today!

timeline.robot_tts: Scanning the skies for jet planes

scanning-again.description: Interstitial for a rescan: robot line (note: 'more'), then three contiguous deep-scan pulses. Matches the production file's transcript + envelope.

timeline.robot_tts: Scanning the skies for more jet planes

overandout.description: Session sign-off: Hugo's farewell, one deep-scan sting. Transcribed from the production ronald file 2026-10-02.

timeline.tts: Great job my old chum, we spotted some absolutely delightful jet planes just now. Start up your Yoto jet plane scanner again soon, because you never know what celestial surprises we might find up there. Hugo, standing by.
